findings.decision: Historical GAP/PLANNED does not override approved basic TASK scope or establish current missing implementation. Verify TaskService and typed link at method level.
Historical BLOCKED_PROVENANCE retained; explicit identity linkage required. Do not infer from email/name. Check current buyer-link owner and evidence.
Consent invariants and existing regression distinct from deferred campaign dispatch.
No paid inference mandatory negative invariant; invoice/payment implementation deferred.
Same archive guard candidate; preserve actor, fixtures, expected deltas until proven identical. No merge.
Concurrent visibility and revocation wording needs owner linearization contract; do not promise retroactive suppression of already-authorized snapshot/bytes.
